title: In a hotel
about: Places and things in a hotel, like reception, the lift and the bill. Simple things to say and ask at a hotel: when you arrive, when you need something and when you leave.

parts.title: Places and things in the hotel

items.pattern: at reception · the reception desk
items.meaning: the desk near the hotel door where you arrive, give your name and get your key
items.example: Dad is asking about the swimming pool at **reception**.
more: Leave your key at **reception** when you go out.
The girl at the **reception** desk speaks four languages.
items.watchOut: На рецепції — at reception (у британській часто без the). Людина, яка там працює, — a receptionist.

items.pattern: the lift · take the lift · the lift isn't working
items.meaning: a small room that carries people up and down in a building
items.example: The **lift** is very small. Only three people can get in.
more: My little brother loves pressing the buttons in the **lift**.
There's a mirror on the wall of the **lift**.
items.watchOut: Британське lift, американське elevator. Обидва слова означають ліфт.

items.pattern: the key to / for room 25 · a key card
items.meaning: a small thing that opens the door of your room
items.example: I've got the **key** for our room. It's number 307.
more: Grandpa always keeps his **keys** in his coat pocket.
In this hotel the **key** is a plastic card.
items.watchOut: Ключ від номера — the key to / for the room, не from the room.

items.pattern: luggage (no plural) · a lot of luggage · a piece of luggage
items.meaning: the bags and suitcases you take on a trip
items.example: We always take too much **luggage** on holiday.
more: Put your **luggage** in the car. We're leaving in five minutes.
My sister's **luggage** is a big pink suitcase.
items.watchOut: Luggage не має множини: не luggages і не a luggage. Кажуть my luggage, a lot of luggage, two bags. Вимова: /ˈlʌɡɪdʒ/, не «люгаж».

items.pattern: the bill · pay the bill · Can I have the bill?
items.meaning: a piece of paper that shows how much money you must pay
items.example: Mum paid the **bill** with her card.
more: The **bill** for the pizza was twenty euros.
Look at the **bill**. They forgot to add our drinks.
items.watchOut: Рахунок у готелі чи кафе британською — the bill (американці в ресторані кажуть check). Не account.

items.pattern: a form · fill in a form · a check-in form
items.meaning: a paper with questions; you write your name, address and other things on it
items.example: At the new school I had to write my name on a long **form**.
more: The **form** asks for your date of birth.
You can get a library card. Just fill in this **form**.

items.pattern: a bathroom · a room with a bathroom · in the bathroom
items.meaning: a room with a toilet, a washbasin and a bath or shower
items.example: Our flat has one small **bathroom**.
more: The cat likes to sleep on the **bathroom** floor.
Please don't stay in the **bathroom** for an hour!
items.watchOut: Bathroom — ціла кімната. Сама ванна — a bath. У британському будинку туалет може бути окремо — the toilet.

items.pattern: a shower · have a shower · in the shower
items.meaning: a thing that sends water down on you so you can wash standing up
items.example: I usually have a quick **shower** after football.
more: My dad sings in the **shower** every morning.
The **shower** in this bathroom is really strong.
items.watchOut: Приймати душ — have a shower або take a shower (обидва вживають). Не make a shower.

items.pattern: watch TV · on TV · turn on / off the TV
items.meaning: a television: a machine with a screen for watching films and programmes
items.example: There's a big **TV** on the wall in our living room.
more: Is there anything good on **TV** tonight?
Grandma watches the news on **TV** every evening.
items.watchOut: Дивитися телевізор — watch TV, зазвичай без the. По телевізору — on TV, не by TV.

items.pattern: the phone in the room · phone sb · answer the phone
items.meaning: you use it to talk to people who are in a different place
items.example: The **phone** next to my bed is ringing.
more: Can you **phone** Grandma and say happy birthday?
Our teacher doesn't let us use a **phone** in class.
items.watchOut: Phone — і іменник, і дієслово: phone reception = зателефонувати на рецепцію (без to).

items.pattern: the mini-bar · in the mini-bar
items.meaning: a very small fridge in a hotel room with drinks and snacks
items.example: The **mini-bar** in our room has water, juice and chocolate.
more: Don't eat the snacks from the **mini-bar**. They're very expensive.
The **mini-bar** is under the desk.

items.pattern: a hairdryer · dry your hair with a hairdryer
items.meaning: a small machine that blows hot air to dry your hair
items.example: I need a **hairdryer**. I can't go out with wet hair.
more: Our **hairdryer** is very loud.
Is there a **hairdryer** in the bathroom?
items.watchOut: Фен — hairdryer (іноді hair dryer). Англійське fan — це вентилятор, а не фен.

items.pattern: a single room (for one person)
items.meaning: a hotel room for one person
items.example: Our teacher had a **single room** on the school trip.
more: A **single room** is cheaper than a double room.
My uncle travels a lot for work, so he always books a **single room**.
items.watchOut: Номер у готелі — a room, не a number. Number — тільки цифра: room number 25.

items.pattern: a double room (for two people)
items.meaning: a hotel room for two people, usually with one big bed
items.example: My parents booked a **double room** for their holiday.
more: Is breakfast included in the price of a **double room**?
The **double room** has a big bed and a balcony.
items.watchOut: Double room зазвичай має одне велике ліжко. Номер із двома окремими ліжками — a twin room.

items.pattern: have / make a reservation (for two nights)
items.meaning: you booked a room before you came
items.example: Mum made a **reservation** at a hotel in Lviv.
more: I have a **reservation** for tonight. My name is Petrenko.
We don't have a **reservation**. Have you got any free rooms?
items.watchOut: «У мене заброньовано» — I have a reservation або I booked a room. Не I have a reserve. Не плутай reservation (бронювання) і reception (рецепція).

items.pattern: a room with a view of the sea / the mountains
items.meaning: a room where you can see something nice from the window
items.example: We had a **room with a view** of the old town.
more: From our window there's a great **view** of the river.
Can we have a **room with a view** of the park, please?
items.watchOut: З видом на море — with a view of the sea, зазвичай з of, не on.

items.pattern: on the ground / first / second floor
items.meaning: in Britain: one floor above the floor at street level
items.example: The breakfast room is **on the first floor**, above reception.
more: My friend lives **on the second floor** of a block of flats in Leeds.
The shop is **on the ground floor**, next to the street.
items.watchOut: У Британії поверх на рівні вулиці — ground floor, тому first floor — це наш другий поверх. На поверсі — on the floor, не in.

items.pattern: take the lift (to the fifth floor) · take the stairs
items.meaning: go up or down in the lift
items.example: Grandma's legs hurt, so we **took the lift**.
more: Let's **take the lift** to the top floor and look at the city.
I never **take the lift**. I like walking up the stairs.
items.watchOut: Поїхати ліфтом — take the lift; піти сходами — take the stairs.

items.pattern: It's over there.
items.meaning: in that place, not near you; you often point with your hand
items.example: Look, our bus is **over there**!
more: Can you see the café **over there**, next to the bank?
Put your bags **over there**, by the door.
items.watchOut: here — тут, there — там, over there — он там (трохи далі, часто показуємо рукою).

items.pattern: (some) help with your luggage · help sb with sth
items.meaning: someone carries your bags for you
items.example: The man at the door gave us some **help with our luggage**.
more: Grandpa, do you need **help with your luggage**?
I can carry my bag. I don't need **help with my luggage**.
items.watchOut: Допомогти з чимось — help with sth, не help in або help for.

items.pattern: fill in a form / this form
items.meaning: write the answers in the empty spaces on a form
items.example: You have to **fill in a form** to join the tennis club.
more: Mum **filled in the form** for my new passport.
Please **fill in this form** with a black pen.
items.watchOut: Заповнити бланк — fill in a form (американці кажуть fill out). Зазвичай не просто fill a form.

items.pattern: sign (your name) here · sign a form
items.meaning: write your name in your own special way
items.example: The postman said, 'Please **sign here**', and gave me the parcel.
more: Dad **signed** my school report.
Read it carefully before you **sign** it.
items.watchOut: Sign — підписати(ся), читається /saɪn/: g не вимовляється. Підпис — a signature.

items.pattern: check the bill / your bill
items.meaning: look at the bill carefully and make sure it is correct
items.example: Always **check your bill** before you pay.
more: Mum **checked the bill** and found a mistake.
Can you **check the bill**? I think it's too much.
items.watchOut: Check тут — перевірити, а не «чек». Чек з магазину — a receipt.

items.pattern: check out (of a hotel) · check in
items.meaning: pay the bill and leave the hotel
items.example: We **checked out** after breakfast and went to the beach.
more: You must **check out** of your room before twelve o'clock.
What time did you **check out** yesterday?
items.watchOut: check in — поселитися (зареєструватися), check out — виїхати. З готелю — check out of the hotel, не from.

items.pattern: Here is / Here's + one thing · Here are + many things · Here you are.
items.meaning: you say this when you give something to someone
items.example: '**Here is your key.** Enjoy your stay!'
more: **Here's** your ticket. The train leaves at ten.
**Here are** your books. Thanks for lending them to me.
items.watchOut: Даючи одну річ, кажуть Here is / Here's…, кілька — Here are…, або просто Here you are.

items.pattern: How much is a room / a ticket? · How much are the rooms?
items.meaning: you ask the price of something
items.example: **How much is** a ticket to the museum?
more: **How much is** this T-shirt?
**How much are** the apples?
items.watchOut: Скільки коштує — How much is…? (або How much does it cost?). Не How much costs…? Для кількох речей — How much are…?

items.pattern: order room service
items.meaning: food and drinks that the hotel brings to your room
items.example: On my birthday we ordered **room service** and had cake in bed.
more: **Room service** is open until midnight.
We were too tired to go out, so we ordered **room service**.

items.pattern: How do I get an outside line?
items.meaning: a phone line for calling people outside the hotel
items.example: Press 9 to **get an outside line**.
more: I couldn't **get an outside line**, so I phoned reception.
The phone in our room can't **get an outside line**.

items.pattern: the code for Poland / Ukraine
items.meaning: the numbers you press first when you phone another country
items.example: **The code for** Ukraine is 380.
more: Do you know **the code for** Spain?
I forgot **the code for** France, so I looked on the internet.
items.watchOut: Код України — the code for Ukraine (зазвичай з for).

items.pattern: have breakfast / lunch / dinner (in your room)
items.meaning: eat breakfast in your hotel room, not in the restaurant
items.example: On Sunday we **had breakfast in our room** and watched cartoons.
more: I usually **have breakfast** at seven.
My sister never **has breakfast**. She just drinks milk.
items.watchOut: Снідати — have breakfast, зазвичай без a / the. Make breakfast — приготувати сніданок, а не з'їсти його.

items.pattern: have / ask for a wake-up call (at 6.30)
items.meaning: the hotel phones you at the time you want to wake up
items.example: Our plane was early, so Dad asked for a **wake-up call** at four.
more: I didn't need a **wake-up call**. The birds woke me up!
Can I have a **wake-up call** at seven tomorrow?
items.watchOut: Прокинутися — wake up, а встати з ліжка — get up. Дзвінок від готелю, щоб розбудити, — зазвичай wake-up call.

items.pattern: What time is breakfast / lunch / dinner?
items.meaning: you ask when something happens or starts
items.example: **What time is** the football match on Saturday?
more: **What time is** your piano lesson?
**What time is** dinner? I'm hungry!
items.watchOut: О котрій — What time…? Не Which time… і не In what hour…

items.pattern: change / exchange money · change dollars into euros
items.meaning: give money of one country and get money of another country
items.example: Before our trip to Poland, we **changed** some money into złoty.
more: You can **exchange money** at the airport.
Where can I **change** dollars into pounds?
items.watchOut: Обміняти гроші — change або exchange money (exchange трохи офіційніше). Іменник change означає ще й решту, дрібні гроші.

example.title: A room by the sea
example.uk:
Софія з мамою приїхали до готелю о дев'ятій вечора. Мама підійшла до рецепції. «У нас заброньовано двомісний номер», — сказала вона. Адміністратор дав їй бланк. «Заповніть його, будь ласка, і розпишіться тут. Ось ваш ключ. Ваш номер на другому поверсі».

Вони поїхали ліфтом. З номера був вид на море, а ще там була велика ванна кімната. Софія зголодніла, тож вони замовили їжу в номер.

Уранці їх розбудив дзвінок з рецепції. «Які чудові канікули!» — сказала Софія.
example.en:
Sofia and her mum arrived at the hotel at nine in the evening. Mum went to [[reception|a1]]. 'We have a [[reservation|b3]] for a [[double room|b2]],' she said. The receptionist gave her a form. 'Please [[fill it in|b9]] and [[sign here|b10]]. [[Here is your key|b13]]. Your room is [[on the first floor|b5]].'

They [[took the lift|b6]]. The room had a [[view|b4]] of the sea and a big [[bathroom|a7]]. Sofia was hungry, so they ordered [[room service|c2]].

In the morning, they had a [[wake-up call|c6]]. 'What a great holiday!' Sofia said.
